name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement for the Enterprise Knowledge Platform.
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

# Feature Request

## Summary

Provide a brief description of the proposed feature.

Example:

> Add document upload functionality through the Enterprise Web UI.

---

## Problem Statement

Describe the problem or limitation this feature addresses.

Example:

> Users currently need to manually place documents in the project directory before they can be indexed.

---

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you would like the feature to work.

Example:

- Upload documents through the web interface
- Automatically process and index uploaded files
- Display upload progress
- Show upload status

---

## Alternative Solutions

Describe any alternative approaches you have considered.

---

## Benefits

How would this feature improve the project?

Examples:

- Better user experience
- Improved productivity
- Easier document management
- Reduced manual work

---

## Additional Context

Include mockups, diagrams, screenshots, references, or links if applicable.

---

## Priority

- [ ] Low
- [ ] Medium
- [ ] High
- [ ] Critical

---

## Implementation Ideas (Optional)

If you have ideas about how this feature could be implemented, describe them here.

---

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing feature requests before creating this request.
- [ ] This feature aligns with the project's goals.
- [ ] I have provided enough information for discussion.
